clue.text: An office in which little or no work gets done

definitions.text: An office in which little or no work gets done

parts.words: An office in which little or no work gets done
parts.note: a plain description of a paid post that asks nothing of its holder, the cryptic touch being that it reads like a complaint about a lazy workplace

explanation.definitionFit: A cushy paid position carrying almost no duties is exactly what this word for a do-nothing job denotes.

clue.text: Old car in a pile-up

definitions.meaning: a battered old vehicle, a banger, is slangily called by this word
a pile or mound of things ... together

explanation.surface: A vintage motor caught up in a motorway crash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pile-up' suggests a road accident, but it simply means a mound, a heap.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang calls a decrepit car this, and the same word means a pile or mound.

clue.text: The wrong path, say, may hold up the bowler

indicators.note: a path gone wrong is one put in the wrong order, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: say means for example, abbreviated EG

explanation.surface: Taking the wrong path might delay a cricket bowler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' rearranges PATH to HATP. The bowler is a hat, not a cricketer, and holding it up means supporting it on a hook.
explanation.definitionFit: A wall hook for hats is what supports a bowler hat when it is hung up.

clue.text: They may be required to be met

definitions.text: They may be required to be met

parts.words: They may be required to be met
parts.note: reads as people expected at an arrival gate, but the things required are claims or requests that must be satisfied

explanation.definitionFit: Requests made firmly are said to be met when they are satisfied, and they are things required of someone.

clue.text: Prospect for gold in American country

indicators.note: the word for gold is set inside the name of the country

parts.note: Panama is a country in Central America
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A miner looking for gold somewhere in the Americas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prospect for gold' looks like a phrase about mining, but 'Prospect' alone is the definition, a view.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a wide view of a landscape, which is what a sweeping panoramic vista is.

clue.text: Current date girl takes round to party with car

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
O is round in shape
a do is a party
the Mini is a classic small British car

explanation.surface: A girl goes off to a party, driving there in a car.
explanation.walkthrough: Current date means the year we are in, counted in the Christian era; the Latin phrase means 'in the year of the Lord'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dates in the present era are given as years of the Lord, the Latin label attached to the current calendar.

clue.text: Left in play

parts.note: a stage direction tells an actor to go off, and an actor who has done so has left during the drama

explanation.definitionFit: Going off stage in a drama is marked by the Latin stage direction, so someone who left has gone out.

clue.text: A letter I composed is well expressed

indicators.note: composed means put together, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A letter I have written is eloquent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' rearranges the eight letters of A LETTER I.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing that is well expressed is educated and articulate, showing command of language.

clue.text: A letter, say, may be an attachment

indicators.note: say signals the words are to be spoken and heard

parts.note: a letter of the alphabet such as an X, so the phrase is 'an X'

explanation.surface: Something sent with a letter, perhaps an enclosure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A letter' is not correspondence but a letter of the alphabet: 'an X' spoken sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An extension added onto a building or document is an addition attached to the main part.

clue.text: Meadow has first of primroses in spring

parts.note: a lea is a meadow, a poetic word

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A field dotted with early primroses in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' looks like the season of primroses, but it is the verb to jump.
explanation.definitionFit: To spring is to jump, a bound into the air.

clue.text: A grand may be a profit one makes

indicators.note: makes means forms, so the letters are formed into something new

explanation.surface: A thousand pounds might be the profit someone earns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A grand' looks like a thousand pounds, but it is a grand piano. 'makes' rearranges A PROFIT ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand is a large piano, one type of the full-named keyboard instrument.

clue.text: A sucker for hypocrisy

definitions.meaning: a hard mint-flavoured boiled sweet to suck

explanation.surface: Someone gullible taken in by hypocrisy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sucker' suggests a dupe, but it is a boiled sweet, which is sucked.
explanation.definitionFit: A striped mint boiled sweet carries this name, which also means deceitful nonsense.

clue.text: A gift for dishonesty?

parts.note: reads as a talent for lying, but means a present given to someone to act dishonestly, a bribe

explanation.definitionFit: A bribe slipped to someone is a payment, a gift handed over in return for corruption.

clue.text: Quarterdeck cutters

definitions.meaning: read as quarter deck: one of the four suits that make up a pack of cards
hard gemstones used for cutting glass

explanation.surface: Blades kept on a ship's quarterdeck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quarterdeck' looks nautical, but split it: a quarter of a deck of cards is one suit.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four card suits is a quarter of the pack, and these hard gems cut glass.

clue.text: Washed up when everyone was in bed

indicators.note: was in places the word for everyone inside the word for bed

parts.note: taken as written
each means every one

explanation.surface: Something washed ashore during the night while everyone slept.
explanation.definitionFit: A whale or boat left stranded on the shore has been washed up.

clue.text: This canine is a biter on sight

definitions.text: This canine is a biter on sight

parts.words: This canine is a biter on sight
parts.note: reads as a dog that bites on sight, but it is the canine tooth, linked to sight because its name involves the organ of vision

explanation.definitionFit: The canine tooth of the upper jaw is popularly named after the organ of sight.

clue.text: Please pay in full

definitions.meaning: to please is to content or gratify someone
to settle a debt or claim completely

explanation.surface: A polite request to settle the bill completely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Please' looks like a polite word, but it is the verb to gratify.
explanation.definitionFit: To content someone is to please them, and to discharge a debt fully is to settle it.

clue.text: Common haunt

explanation.surface: A ghost that commonly haunts a place.
explanation.definitionFit: Something common occurs often, and to haunt a place is to visit it often.

clue.text: He's made pretence a reality!

parts.note: pretence here is a claim to a throne; one who has seized the throne has turned that claim into fact

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who seizes a throne wrongfully makes a pretender's claim real by taking power.

clue.text: Bread counters?

parts.note: bread is slang for money, so these are people who count money, not bakery shelves

explanation.definitionFit: Bank or shop staff who handle and count money are money counters, bread being slang for cash.

clue.text: Grants a minor point

parts.note: a ward is a minor in the care of a guardian
S is a compass point, south

explanation.surface: A small concession granted in an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minor point' looks like a trivial detail; split it into a ward and a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: Grants are prizes or sums given, as are awards.

clue.text: Bridge expert in court

definitions.meaning: Sir Donald ... designed the portable military bridge named after him
the outer courtyard of a castle; also the Old ..., London's central criminal court

explanation.surface: A bridge-playing expert appears in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bridge' suggests the card game, but it is a structure: the Bailey bridge was devised by the engineer Donald Bailey.
explanation.definitionFit: The engineer behind the Bailey bridge shares his surname with a castle's walled courtyard.

clue.text: One can't run out of it

definitions.text: One can't run out of it

parts.words: One can't run out of it
parts.note: reads as an endless supply, but means that a runner who is out of puff cannot run

explanation.definitionFit: Air drawn into the lungs is needed to keep running, and someone without it is gasping.

clue.text: Not a starter in the ocean race

parts.note: the main is a poetic name for the open sea
a course is a racecourse or race track

explanation.surface: A yacht that is not entered at the start of an ocean race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starter' suggests a race starter, but it is a first course of a meal; the dish that is not one is the main.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal dish of a meal comes after the starter, so it is not one.

clue.text: Show displeasure when nothing is in place

indicators.note: is in puts the zero letter inside the word for place

parts.note: to place is to put
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Sulking when nothing is where it should be.
explanation.definitionFit: To push out the lips sulkily is a way to show displeasure.

clue.text: It isn't all go

definitions.meaning: a portion, less than the whole

explanation.walkthrough: 'go' looks like energy, as in 'all go', but it means leave.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion is something less than the whole, and to depart is to go.

clue.text: The arrival of a commercial airway

parts.note: an ad is a commercial, an advertisement
a vent is an opening that lets air through

explanation.surface: A new commercial airline route is launched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'commercial airway' suggests an airline; split it into an advert and an air vent.
explanation.definitionFit: The coming or arrival of something important is its advent.

clue.text: Points to small boy put in the high chair

annotationWithheld.clue: Points to small boy put in the high chair
